requirements.condition: A packet contains one or more PADDING frames.
requirements.required_behavior: Treat the packet as in flight for congestion-control purposes.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not exclude the packet from bytes in flight merely because it contains PADDING frames.
requirements.why_checkable: A congestion-control implementation can be tested or inspected to verify that packets containing PADDING frames are recorded as in flight.

requirements.condition: A packet contains only PADDING frames.
requirements.required_behavior: Account the packet against the congestion window.
requirements.why_checkable: Congestion-window accounting can be observed after sending a packet whose frames are exclusively PADDING.

requirements.condition: A packet contains only PADDING frames.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not treat the packet as generating an acknowledgment that opens the congestion window.
requirements.why_checkable: Acknowledgment generation and congestion-window opening can be observed after receipt of a packet containing only PADDING frames.

requirements.quote:
avoid a deadlock, a sender SHOULD ensure that other frames are sent
   periodically in addition to PADDING frames to elicit acknowledgments
   from the receiver.
requirements.condition: A sender sends PADDING frames and needs to avoid congestion-window deadlock.
requirements.required_behavior: Periodically send frames other than PADDING frames in addition to PADDING frames so that the receiver is elicited to acknowledge.
requirements.why_checkable: A sender's emitted frame sequence can be inspected over time to determine whether non-PADDING frames are periodically included to elicit acknowledgments.
